outtake.definition: n. a scene that is filmed but is not used in the final editing of the film
outtake.translation: 通气管, 气孔, 通风道, 烟道

outtaken.definition: p. p. or prep. Excepted; save.
outtaken.translation: n. 通风孔；排气道；（电影的）被剪片断

outtalk.definition:
v. t. To overpower by talking; to exceed in talking; to talk
   down.
outtalk.translation: vt. 讲得比...多(或快、好、久)

outtell.definition: v. t. To surpass in telling, counting, or reckoning.
outtell.translation: vt. 说出；宣告, 宣布; 比…更能讲述；叙述效果超过; 全部讲完

outthink.translation: 思考得比...来得深入、迅速或老练

outthrow.definition:
v. t. To throw out.
v. t. To excel in throwing, as in ball playing.
outthrow.translation:
vt. 扔出, 抛出, 比...扔得更远更准
n. 扔出, 迸发, 废料

outthrust.definition: n. an outcropping of rock that extends outward
outthrust.translation:
v. (使)突出, (使)冲出
a. 突出的, 冲出的
n. 突出, 冲出, 突出物

outtongue.definition: v. t. To silence by talk, clamor, or noise.

outtop.translation: vt.升在…之上, 在高度上超过

outtrade.translation: vt. 买卖中占(某人)的上风, 占(某人)的便宜

outtravel.definition: v. t. To exceed in speed o/ distance traveled.

outtrump.translation: vt. 在比赛上胜过, 制胜(对方), 在比赛上击败

outturn.definition: n what is produced in a given time period
outturn.translation:
n. 产量, 产品质量
[经] 卸货(船)数量条款

outturn report.translation: [经] 产量样品, 货物送达时所取的货样

outturns.definition:
plural of outturn
n what is produced in a given time period
outturns.translation:
(outturn 的复数) n. 产量, 产品质量
[经] 卸货(船)数量条款
